en: Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a central, two‑storey building with a tiled roof and dormer windows, flanked symmetrically by two smaller houses with similar roofs. A hedge-lined garden and curved paths lead to a white gate in the foreground. The style suggests an early 20th‑century institutional building. Printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom border.
